explanation: A mountain in Jerusalem, often used as a symbol of God's presence and protection.
A title for God, the almighty Creator of the universe and all life.
To be around or on all sides, here referring to God's protection and presence.
To protect and preserve, here it refers to God's care for His people.
People who live according to God's will and moral standards.
People who do not follow God's will and moral standards, and act sinfully.
The absence of conflict and strife, as well as harmony and well-being among people and with God.
